# mcpc skill text (vendored)

`SKILL.md` is the agent guide that [mcpc](https://github.com/apify/mcpc) prints with `mcpc help --skill` (the same file as `skills/mcpc/SKILL.md` in the `@apify/mcpc` package), copied unchanged from mcpc 0.7.0. The token benchmark and the agent evaluation count it as mcpc's instruction text, the counterpart of `via prompt`. It is vendored so that the benchmark stays offline and reproducible.
